name: Saltwarden Online
summary: Saltwarden Online is a 2D real-time MMORPG developed by a single developer and inspired by classic MMORPGs. It is set in Vessar, 31 years after a war ended with a weapon that drained a sea; the dead have begun to return and magic has become unpredictable. Players take the role of Wardens in the borderlands between the Concordat and the Free Banners. The game features tab-targeted combat with telegraphed attacks, weapon and defence skills that improve through use, quests and reputation, a dungeon for five players without an automatic group finder, and a separate realm with permanent character death. It is played in a web browser on desktop and on Android devices with touch controls.
